pages.title: The Frosttide's Wake
pages.text: Ice dragon blood leaves its chill in the weapons it tempers. The fin draws on the same power, carrying cold through a tail sweep to slow those struck and bring a wave of nausea.

pages.title: Crafting the Fin
pages.text: Collect Dragon Ice Spikes left by an ice dragon's breath with a Silk Touch tool.

pages.title: Laying Out the Fin
pages.text: Place a Hippocampus Fin in the center, with Shiny Scales to either side and Ice Dragon Blood directly above and below. Put Dragon Ice Spikes in both lower corners.

pages.title: The Tail's Cold Wake
pages.text: In either form, tail sweeps reach 20%% farther, deal 15%% more damage and trace an arc of frost. Hits inflict Slowness III and Nausea III for 5 seconds; enemies other than ice dragons are also frozen for 3 seconds. These effects do not apply to ordinary claw attacks or breath.
